table: candidate envelope rate table, 128 entries, u16 big-endian
source: EOS v4.62 OS image, offset 0x0edd56 in the container payload (payload starts 0x200 after the 0x12345678 header)
IDENTITY_IS_INFERRED: Found by SHAPE, not by matching published values -- E-mu publish no anchors. 128 entries (one per MIDI parameter byte), monotone descending, log-linear. That is consistent with an envelope rate table and is NOT proof it is one. Confirm by changing the parameter on hardware and predicting a value from the entry.
VERSION_CAVEAT: This is 4.62. The bench runs 4.70, whose OS image is packed (RESOLUTION_NOTES 116/122) and cannot be read. Treat as a cross-check, not a reference.
NOT_A_SINGLE_EXPONENTIAL: r2 is 0.99994 over 60-100 and only 0.9895 over the whole table. The ends are steeper (0.128 below byte 20, 0.078 above byte 100). Our law is right where it was fitted and wrong outside it, which is a firmware-side explanation for RESOLUTION_NOTES 105's 'not to be read below ~2 s'.
